name: sitemills-cli
description: SiteMills CLI Tool - Project Code Management on the SiteMills Platform

scripts.obfuscate: npx -y javascript-obfuscator bin/updater.js --output dist/updater.js --compact true --self-defending false --string-array true --string-array-encoding base64 --string-array-threshold 0.75 --reserved-strings 'updater' && npx -y javascript-obfuscator bin/sitemills.js --output dist/sitemills.js --compact true --self-defending false --string-array true --string-array-encoding base64 --string-array-threshold 0.75 --reserved-strings 'updater'
scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && npm run obfuscate && npx -y pkg dist/sitemills.js --targets node18-linux-x64,node18-macos-x64,node18-win-x64 --out-path dist/binaries
